tools.description: Look up vet402's published purchase record for one x402 URL. Read-only. It does not pay. Pass url: the absolute https x402 URL. check_x402_seller shows what happened when vet402 paid an x402 URL: whether the payment settled, whether content came back, and the transaction where vet402 recorded one. F

tools.description: Read a seller payment receipt on its chain. Read-only. It does not pay. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, find_x402_sellers · Private data: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, check_8004_agent, check_nearai_attestation, check_concordium_agent, find_x402_sellers · Public sink: check_x402_seller, find_x402_sellers · Destructive: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_nearai_attestation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, find_x402_sellers · Private data: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, check_8004_agent, check_nearai_attestation, check_concordium_agent, find_x402_sellers · Public sink: check_x402_seller, find_x402_sellers · Destructive: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_nearai_attestation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
